t.first_reported_at ASC t.first_reported_at DESC

CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log a WHERE a.target_type = ${tt} AND a.target_id = t.target_id AND a.source = 'admin' AND a.status = 'pending') THEN 'admin_blind' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log a WHERE a.target_type = ${tt} AND a.target_id = t.target_id AND a.source <> 'admin' AND a.status <> 'rejected') THEN 'admin_delete' WHEN ${stateCol} = 'blind' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moderation_log m WHERE m.target_type = ${tt} AND m.target_id = t.target_id AND m.applied_state = 'blind' AND m.acted_by IS NULL AND m.action_id = (SELECT MAX(m2.action_id) FROM moderation_log m2 WHERE m2.target_type = ${tt} AND m2.target_id = t.target_id AND m2.applied_state IN ('blind', 'deleted', 'normal'))) THEN 'auto_blind' ELSE 'report' END AS kind
mapper.select:
SELECT 'post' AS targetType, t.target_id AS targetId, p.post_id AS postId, LEFT(p.content, 30) AS preview, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, u.user_id AS authorId, u.name AS authorName, rs.label AS reasonLabel, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r2.source = 'admin' THEN CONCAT('관리자(', ru.name, ')') ELSE ru.name END ORDER BY r2.created_at SEPARATOR ', ') FROM reports_log r2 JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r2.reporter_id WHERE r2.target_type = 'post' AND r2.target_id = t.target_id AND r2.status <> 'rejected') AS reporterNames, t.first_reported_at AS firstReportedAt, t.report_count AS reportCount, r.status AS reportStatus, p.state AS state,
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'comment' AS targetType, t.target_id AS targetId, p.post_id AS postId, LEFT(c.content, 30) AS preview, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, u.user_id AS authorId, u.name AS authorName, rs.label AS reasonLabel, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r2.source = 'admin' THEN CONCAT('관리자(', ru.name, ')') ELSE ru.name END ORDER BY r2.created_at SEPARATOR ', ') FROM reports_log r2 JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r2.reporter_id WHERE r2.target_type = 'comment' AND r2.target_id = t.target_id AND r2.status <> 'rejected') AS reporterNames, t.first_reported_at AS firstReportedAt, t.report_count AS reportCount, r.status AS reportStatus, c.state AS state,
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, CASE WHEN r.source = 'admin' THEN CONCAT('관리자(', ru.name, ')') ELSE ru.name END AS reporterName, rs.label AS reasonLabel, r.detail AS detail, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.status AS status FROM reports_log r LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON r.reason_id = rs.reason_id WHERE r.target_type = #{targetType} AND r.target_id = #{targetId} AND r.status <> 'rejected' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.report_id ASC
SELECT code FROM reasons WHERE reason_id = #{reasonId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports_log (reporter_id, source, target_type, target_id, reason_id, detail, status, created_at, resolved_at, resolution_action_id, origin_action_id) VALUES (#{reporterId}, 'admin', #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reasonId}, #{detail}, #{status}, NOW(), CASE WHEN #{status} = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE #{actionId} END, #{actionId})
mapper.select: SELECT post_id FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT name FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT acted_by IS NOT NULL FROM moderation_log WHERE target_type = 'post' AND target_id = #{postId} AND applied_state IN ('blind', 'deleted') ORDER BY action_id DESC LIMIT 1
